name: MiniMax H3 1x RTX 3090 ECO MASTER WORKFLOW
goal: Minimum practical energy use and heat on one RTX 3090 while preserving the chosen render-quality settings. Power tuning may reduce speed, but should not intentionally change model quality settings.

target_hardware.platform: Linux preferred; Windows supported with equivalent power-limit/undervolt tooling

quality_neutral_controls: keeping the same model, seed, resolution, sampler, scheduler, steps and CFG
important_distinction.policy: Strict-quality profiles never enable quality-changing controls automatically.

single_gpu_architecture.loader_policy: Use the normal/native single-GPU H3 loader/workflow, not MiniMaxH3SPUNETLoader.
single_gpu_architecture.reason: No SP overhead and no extra SP VAE memory duplication on a single 24GB card.

notes: With 128GB system RAM, do not add memory workarounds unless measurements show a real problem.
--disable-pinned-memory can dramatically reduce host-RAM pressure on RAM-constrained single-3090 systems, but can reduce transfer performance; benchmark it on the actual machine.
--fp16-intermediates is a memory-saving option, not part of the strict reference-quality baseline.

power_policy.selection_rule: Choose the power limit that minimizes measured Wh per completed render while staying inside the user's acceptable render-time penalty and passing the same-seed visual comparison.
power_policy.quality_note: A power limit changes clock/power behavior, not the configured diffusion trajectory. It should not intentionally alter quality, but unstable undervolts/thermal errors are invalid and must be rejected.

measure: visual hash / same-seed comparison where practical
energy_benchmark_protocol.winner: Lowest Wh_per_render that remains stable and within acceptable runtime.

01_ECO_STRICT_QUALITY.purpose: Reduce heat and electricity without intentionally changing render-quality settings.
01_ECO_STRICT_QUALITY.model_policy: Keep the exact same diffusion model and text encoder used by the user's reference-quality workflow.
notes: This is the safest power-saving profile.
If 250W costs too much time, use 260W or 280W; quality settings remain unchanged.

02_ECO_BALANCED_280W.purpose: Keep most stock throughput while cutting heat and power substantially.

03_SINGLE_3090_PRODUCTION.resolution: 1280x736 when practical; use the exact project's chosen reference resolution

04_SINGLE_3090_MAX_QUALITY.purpose: Maximum-quality final render with lower GPU power draw.

05_OPTIONAL_NATIVE_AMPERE_SPEED_TEST.purpose: Optional A/B test for lower total energy through faster Ampere-native quantized execution.
05_OPTIONAL_NATIVE_AMPERE_SPEED_TEST.candidate_text_encoder: Ampere-native INT8/ConvRot encoder if available for the exact workflow
05_OPTIONAL_NATIVE_AMPERE_SPEED_TEST.policy: Do not promote to default without same-seed A/B quality review and Wh/render benchmark.
05_OPTIONAL_NATIVE_AMPERE_SPEED_TEST.reason: Current community reports show native INT8/ConvRot can be materially faster than emulated FP8/NVFP4 paths on RTX 3090, but changing quantization can change outputs.

06_OPTIONAL_SAGE_TEST.policy: A/B against clean baseline. Reject if seed reproducibility, motion, detail or prompt adherence changes materially.
06_OPTIONAL_SAGE_TEST.reason: Single-3090 reports are mixed: some show large speedups, others show negligible benefit. Treat as workload/version-specific.

128gb_ram_machine.default: Use normal ComfyUI memory management first.
128gb_ram_machine.disable_pinned_memory: Only after measured host-RAM/pinned-memory growth or OOM symptoms.
128gb_ram_machine.fp16_intermediates: Optional memory-saving mode; benchmark before making it persistent.
128gb_ram_machine.swap: Safety net only; not a performance feature.

32gb_ram_machine.reason: Verified community setups show host-RAM pinning can be the actual bottleneck on single 3090.

thermals.policy: Prefer lower power limit and stable cooling over overclocking.

targets.memory_junction: monitor on 3090; avoid sustained thermal-throttle territory

undervolt.rule: Only use a previously stability-tested voltage/frequency curve. A crash, artifact or CUDA error invalidates the undervolt.

quality_guardrails: Power saving must not be achieved by lowering resolution in strict-quality mode.
Power saving must not be achieved by lowering steps in strict-quality mode.
Turbo remains OFF for strict final-quality profiles.
Approximate caches remain OFF for strict final-quality profiles.
Attention replacements remain OFF until separately A/B validated.
Keep a fixed-seed clean reference clip for every persistent optimization decision.

recommended_daily_choice.reason: Power limiting is the clearest quality-neutral lever. It reduces heat and instantaneous draw without changing the configured model/steps/resolution.

recommended_calibration.choose_by: Wh/render, stability, and acceptable render-time penalty.
recommended_calibration.then: Keep that power limit as machine default.
recommended_calibration.do_not: Assume the lowest wattage is the cheapest render.

do_not_do: Do not use the 2-GPU Ulysses/SP loader on a 1-GPU profile.
Do not treat a lower power limit as a reason to lower quality settings.
Do not stack Turbo, caches and attention replacements in the strict-quality lane.
Do not assume NVFP4/FP8 paths are fastest on Ampere; benchmark native INT8/ConvRot separately.
Do not change quantization and claim identical output without A/B validation.
Do not judge energy efficiency from watts alone; measure Wh per render.

main_changes: Removed Ulysses sequence parallel and all 2-GPU loader assumptions.
Separated strict quality-neutral tuning from optional quantization/attention experiments.
Adjusted memory policy for single-GPU operation.
